physics_goals.quote: Pulse shape analysis has been applied to discriminate between nuclear recoils, as may be caused by WIMP interactions, and electron recoils due to gamma background.
physics_goals.value: Search for WIMP nuclear recoils in NaI(Tl) crystals using pulse shape discrimination

summary.plain: NaIAD was an array of sodium iodide crystals in the Boulby mine in north-east England that searched for dark matter from 2000 to 2003. It saw no dark matter and, for a time, set the tightest limits on dark matter that interacts through spin.
summary.technical: NaI Advanced Detector: array of 2 encapsulated and 4 unencapsulated NaI(Tl) crystals with high light yield and pulse shape discrimination; 44.9 kg yr analysed in the final results; no WIMP nuclear-recoil signal in any run. The abstract says it imposed the most stringent constraints on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross-section 'so far'. UKDMC experiment, a DAMA-type target.
